propositions: When a child ticket has a non-epic parent in a Jira project that permits only epic parents, the parent field is suppressed outbound but the child lacks context about its ancestry.

An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must be emitted from the outbound comment differ to point the Jira user at the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, using RECONCILER_MARKER for inbound suppression and a stable tag for append-once idempotency.
The breadcrumb walk traverses local_parents upward to find the nearest ancestor with a Jira binding, skipping unbound intervening ancestors and noting them in the body if present.
The breadcrumb deduplicates on a stable identity tag (rebar:parent-breadcrumb), not on the variable ancestor key, so it survives across passes even if the nearest represented ancestor changes.
The outbound suppression condition (non-epic parent in epic-only project) and the breadcrumb gate fire on identical children to maintain parity.
